executive_summary: Delivered an in-browser CV reader: a shareable /cv?track=flutter|frontend page that embeds the PDF inline, plus a mobile/coarse-pointer fallback with Open PDF and Download. api/download-cv now honours mode=view (Content-Disposition: inline, nosniff, Range requests uncounted) and writes to a separate v:cvview:* key family, so in-page reads and downloads are tracked independently; visit-stats exposes an additive cvViews field and the dashboard gained its own 'CV views' card and reset scope. visit-reset's cv scope provably cannot wipe view keys. Hero and Navbar gained a Read CV link on desktop and mobile with both existing download paths unchanged. Zero new npm dependencies; /cv ships as its own lazy chunk and mode=view no longer leaks into the entry bundle.
